name: Liddie Kumar
source:
A mathematician and researcher at Viktor Chondria University; 28 years old.

Liddie is very fond of solving worldly phenomena mathematically, and she makes a hobby out of showing others the wonders of mathematics.

Even aside from math, her numerous other talents garner her plenty of media presence and popularity.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
